Professor V: Commander? It's V. I'll be overviewing your mission while Dispatcher is… away.
Professor V: From what I can tell, Patient Zero's virus has started to evolve. It'll definitely need to be studied, so drag me back a corpse or two?
Professor V: That looks like a Bolt zombie! Medic has been dying to cut into one of those!
Professor V: Hmm… Maybe when she's done, I could use a hydraulic press and shove it into a battery.
Commander: There is something seriously wrong with the both of you!

Commander: I see a Living Experiment up ahead!
Commander: Take it out quickly!
Commander: Concentrate your fire on that Speedy Boss! Don't let it get past us!
Professor V: Hey Commander, I've made some discoveries going through the files.
Professor V: It seems a medical specialist named Dr. Herrschaft used to work at a local town hospital, but was fired for experimenting on his patients.
Professor V: According to the documents gathered so far, he spent time as a virologist who worked on viruses that were thousands of years old. That's insane.
Professor V: Here's some more. It was a hunch, but Dr. Herrschaft had created the foundation for the healing tech we use because of his cell replication studies.

Commander: That healing technology is based off of a virus that forces damaged cells to repair and multiply, and that was the center of his work. Instead of losing all that research, TDS took possession of it and had Medic create a healing particle beam. Woah.
Professor V: From my guess, Dr. Herrschaft lost his license and went to his hometown to work on the virus once more. This date is right around the time the zombie outbreak happened!

Professor V: Wait... What if Dr. Herrschaft is Patient Zero? I mean, it wasn't until after the zombies started taking over the cities, and if he were to get infected it wouldn't surprise me he would be first in contact.
Commander: I'll contact Headquarters. This discovery needs to be reported ASAP. Keep everything that was found between you and I.
Professor V: Yes sir...
Commander: We've got eyes on Patient Zero. Make sure all units are ready!
Commander: When we get back to base, I'm going to have a long talk with Medic.
Commander: There's Patient Zero, give it everything we've got!

dialogue: Dispatcher: Heads up Commander. We've tracked unusual activity nearby and the temperature is plummeting.

Commander: Yes Ma'am!
Professor V: I've been tracking these anomalies for weeks! Creatures have been coming out of these random pockets of frost and I just have to know where they're coming from!
Commander: Hey V, what do we know about these things so far?
Professor V: Hacker sent some drones into the frost so it'll be some time until we know more. I can't wait!
Dispatcher: I'm not liking what I'm seeing. Commander, it might be time to set up some hidden detection!
Commander: Yes Ma'am! I'm on it!
Professor V: That's incredible! Those Cold Mists are using droplets of water to refract the light and make themselves nearly invisible!
Commander: I meant to ask. How do we know the names of these things anyway?
Professor V: The research team has a dart board and they just kinda'-*click*.
Commander: Right-... Got it.
Professor V: Is that a Frost Mystery?! It's been years since we've seen one! You just HAVE to bring one back for me!
Commander: So you can do what you did to that other creature? No way!
Professor V: You really suck the fun out of research, don't you?
Commander: If I knew they were frost enemies, I would have brought Pyro. These snowballs keep stunning us!
Dispatcher: Have you tried, I don't know... ducking?
Commander: I think one's enough.
Professor V: So that's what they were. I knew I saw something flying over a building in the photos! Why do they seem so...sad?
Commander: Please don't do that.
Professor V: We've finally got something back from Hacker. It's not much, but we did learn a few things.
Professor V: In the few pictures we transmitted, it shows a massive city carved completely out of ice and stone. Primitive by our standards, but the designs are impressive!
Professor V: We've trying to see what they're using to connect to our realm, but it's so cold there that the drones are freezing in only a few seconds. I'll let you know if we find out more.
Professor V: Does it seem like fighting with strategy? That would mean something is commanding them.
Commander: It's a bit hard to think when you are shooting something you can barely see!
Professor V: Hey, uh... I see something crawling out of the frost.
Professor V: It might be a good idea to start building up our defenses a bit more.
Commander: On it!
Commander: I am freezing-I can barely feel my fingers! The more of these things that show up, the colder it gets!
Dispatcher: I'm starting to think we should have brought Freezer instead. I bet he'd feel right at home-and won't complain too much.
Commander: That's easy to say when you're not the one out here!
Dispatcher: Heads up! Looks like you have something coming.
Commander: 'Something' is putting it lightly. Those Frost Hunters are terrifying!
Professor V: Yeah they are!
Commander: Whats [sic] wrong with you?
Commander: There's [sic] some Frost Ravagers coming! Take out their shields!
Professor V: ...and collect the pieces! I want to study what they're made out of!
Dispatcher: I think I'm going to send you into the field next time since you want to research everything.
Professor V: Please don't...
Dispatcher: V, have you learned anything else about the Frost Realm?
